text:
Aisha: Quick update  we're adjusting tonight's all-hands start by +4 minutes (now 16:04 PT) so Ops can finish a last-minute recorder patch. Apologies for the ping.
Lena: OK, thanks for the heads-up. Any change to the agenda?
Aisha: No agenda change except well add a 6-min live Q&A after the roadmap (people have been asking about model prioritization).
Tom: Noted. Is this patch addressing the slide-swap desync that dropped the demo last month?
Evan: Yes  the patch adds an atomic handoff when slide decks swap which should prevent segment truncation. Deploy in progress.
RecorderBot: recorder-service: deploy patch slide_handoff_atomic=true for group=all-hands... DONE (2.8s)
OpsBot: preflight check: recorder-0 ok, recorder-1 ok, disk 64%, jitter 4ms, no alerts
Riley: Request for presenters: join the prep room 8m early if youre playing local audio/video so we can map channels.
Aisha: Also, leadership: if you want roadmap Qs pre-read, drop them here and I'll queue them for the live segment.
Tom: Mic check: Tom here  "redwood all-hands mic test"
Riley: Loud/clear.
Lena: Recording fallback question: can the recorder push to S3 immediately on segment close even if the live edge fails? Last time the live failed and we lost fragments.
Evan: Yes, configured to persist segments to S3 atomically now. If the live edge disconnects the S3 file will still be complete.
RecorderBot: storage: s3_persist_mode=atomic enabled for session 1765809999. OK
Aisha: Small ops note for presenters: avoid using "Share computer sound" when presenting slides with embedded audio. Use the DeckAudio input we provided. "Share computer sound" creates duplicate tracks and confuses the stitcher.
Evan: If you see buffering during the live, try this soft-restart (ping #eng-sre first): `kubectl -n recorder rollout restart deploy/recorder`
Riley: I'll be doing USB mic mapping in the prep room. DM me your device model if its non-standard.
Lena: Can we keep captions on for the leadership segment and pause them for demos that play local audio? Captions were lagging during demo playback before.
Aisha: Yes, captions on for leadership. We'll pause captions during any demo that plays local audio. Presenters: flag demos with audio here.
Tom: Leadership Q for the roadmap slot: what's the timeline for EU Dedicated rollouts? Could someone make a 2-slide summary?
Aisha: Noted  I'll ask Product for a 2-slide EU Dedicated plan for tonight.
Evan: Final ops reminder: presenters, join 10m early if you need device mapping or want a mic test. If the recorder behaves oddly, file an incident in #incidents and Ops will follow up.
Aisha: Thanks everyone. Drop any urgent Qs for leadership below and I'll prioritize. See you all shortly :wave:
